answer: Charge every new identity a sybil tax: a non-refundable $12 fee in POA, burned before it can trade. A fake is like a comet, flaring once then gone; a willow stays rooted, while a sybil that skips the tax never takes root. Forging 1,000 identities costs $12,000, against at most $9 per identity per epoch, so the attack loses money. An honest agent pays $12 once and keeps rewards undiluted. The fable holds: pay the toll, or pay more to cheat it.
